title: Tower and Music
body: Given the opportunity to choose a game to design a level for, Halo was an obvious choice for an architecture student. The game has a large focus on experiential qualities, paired with larger-than-life architectural moves that take inspiration from Gothic Cathedrals. The focus of this level was on framing views and creating a spiritual experience for the player. For this, I created a central tower to both guide players through the level and also create awe-inspiring spaces that the player can enjoy. The music that I composed for the level took inspiration from Halo’s existing soundtrack, but added the pipe organ for its spiritual qualities, larger-than-life appearance and sound, and striking similarity to the architecture of Halo.
